vo_ed_clean_room_reset_1.evidence: At 512 px a woman handles a blue book at the shelf; native pixels show its cover beside upright spines but do not expose a receiving gap or prove that it is entering rather than being held or removed.

vo_ed_clean_room_reset_2.evidence: The sideboard is visible at both scales. A small thin rectangular outline appears on top at native size, but it does not read as a recent book-sized cleared patch, and it is barely legible at 512 px.

vo_ed_clean_room_reset_3.evidence: A throw drapes over the sofa arm at both scales, but it reads as ordinary finished decor; a half-folded pending tidy task is not distinguishable.

vo_ed_clean_room_reset_4.evidence: Both scales show an uninterrupted broad wood-floor lane connecting the bookcase position past the sofa into the room.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: At native size both acting hands connect through visible arms to the sole woman and touch the same blue book.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: Her shoulders, elbows, and hands form a plausible chain reaching the near shelf; the torso is close to the bookcase.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: At native size her full figure and both white shoes contact the wood floor under a balanced upright stance.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Fingers contact the blue cover, but the fore-edge and empty receiving gap are not independently visible; halfway insertion cannot be confirmed at native size.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The wider view now shows her feet and room, but the book-to-gap relationship stays too small at 512 px and ambiguous at native size.

supplemental_observations.comparison_to_attempt_1: Full-body support and broad room path became visible; the core return and two tidy-in-progress relations remain unqualified.
